newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador's crude up to $18.38 per barrel.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's crude up to $18.38 per barrel.

text.p: The reference price of Ecuador's crude grew to an average $18.38 per barrel on August 28, up from $18.35 registered the day before, a spokesman for state-run Petroecuador said Tuesday.
The price is tied to the Alaska North Slope (USG) price and Oman crude price, with different discounts payable in 30 days.
The average price in July was $17.46 per barrel, while in July 1995 was $14.13 per barrel.
Ecuador withdrew from the Organization of Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) in December 1992.
